Sample Line Code Validator

Validates pipe-delimited line-item schedule records against numeric, code and table rules.

What this tool does not cover

  • Checks syntax, lengths and allowed unit codes only; does not verify pricing reasonableness.
  • Synthetic fixture rule set, not an active agency schedule instruction.

Column rules

Delimiter: pipe. Header row expected: yes.

ColumnLabelRequiredRule
clin Line item number [1] Yes Digits 0-9 (4 to 6 characters)
acct_code Account code [1] Yes Upper-case code starting with AC- (6 to 10 characters)
unit Unit of issue [2] Yes Listed in Allowed unit codes
note Line description [1] Optional Plain text (0 to 40 characters)

Allowed unit codes [2]: EA, HR, LOT, MO
